question: Which selected native unit-coordinate update and snap paths support Fast or Instant movement experiments that are limited to the selected paths, while preserving the non-specialized command lifecycle?

scope.boundary: Selected coordinate update, timing and native snap for non-specialized units. No actual invocation, complete set of animation and model callback paths, applied camera, specialized-unit equivalence or peer-local policy was observed.

dependencies.use: accepted non-specialized simulation-before-presentation, synchronous wait and command completion
accepted presenter and application-callback negatives, rejected cooldown and independent combat control
accepted shared 0x830E4550 game-state transfer, preventing a local-option assumption

currentEvidence.method: foreground ReadOnly DumpMemoryWords dumps, exact-flat selected-word comparison, limited generated-code corroboration in the exact function and arithmetic discriminators

counterexamples: Halving scalar 85 at delta 17 changes step 1 to 0.
Snapping auxiliary X and Y does not write unit queued destination or bypass native auxiliary-action work.

currentEvidence.qualification: Counts include data, padding and repeated context; configured repaired-thunk words are not original behavior. Selected words match the pinned flat. Generated code only corroborates local dataflow; no full set of callers or paths, original thunk effects, compatible indirect return or execution is inferred.

coordinateOwner.children: Definition-selected child loops at 0x82D60CDC..0x82D60DC4. Child c uses A+0x4C+4*c and A+0x70+4*c; auxiliary action uses A+0x28+2*c. This is a logical unit presentation updater rather than a proved newly allocated movement actor type.
coordinateOwner.target: 0x82D5BBF4..0x82D5BC24 derives initial target outputs from U+0x1C and U+0x1E times 1024; the preserved local helper applies definition and formation offsets. Caller 0x82D60DC4 receives outputs, later reloaded at 0x82D60E28/30.
coordinateOwner.distance: 0x82D61170..0x82D61260 computes a signed approximate X and Y distance and handles horizontal wrap before using it for progression.
coordinateOwner.qualification: Actual displayed child identity, transform callback delivery and an executing link from Move17 to this updater remain unobserved.

nativeTiming.delta: 0x82D60044..0x82D60084 converts frame scalar to milliseconds and clamps 0x8314F04C to 1..250. It is shared with other presentation.
nativeTiming.scalar: 0x82D61884..0x82D618B8 derives a scalar from 0x82FFE7C8 and 0x8312B8DC. 0x82D618C0..0x82D61978 can adjust it from queued-route distance and clamped definition+0x42. No new semantic option names are assigned.
nativeTiming.flag: 0x82D6197C..0x82D61994 halves scalar when 0x830E4550 bit 0x400 is set. This does not establish a Fast option and can reduce quantum 1 to 0 in the supplied positive-input example. The word has other gameplay and command readers and accepted native serialization.
nativeTiming.typeTiming: 0x82D5CC98 has eight distinct returned timing values spanning 40..100, consumed at 0x82D6127C..0x82D612F0 for auxiliary +0x3A; this does not identify a universal step duration.
nativeTiming.qualification: No native menu, debug or scenario Instant option or AI-only speed input is established by the selected code. Computed values keep native signed and low32 behavior.

snapAndCompletion.snap: 0x82D619C0/C8 store both target coordinates and merge into 0x82D62030 through 0x82D619CC/D8. Native 0x82D61860..80 also chooses a snap arm for distance > 3072, the selected observer or visibility state, or shared bit 0x40.
snapAndCompletion.busy: 0x82D60050/54 clears busy 0x02000000 at updater entry. Above the near-target threshold, 0x82D619EC sets selected active work and 0x82D61A10 ORs the busy bit and 0x82D61A18 stores it. Exact snap omits this one busy set, without proving absence of other writers.
snapAndCompletion.arrival: 0x82D62030..0x82D6204C tests both exact target coordinates. 0x82D62050..0x82D6212C keeps native auxiliary action and arrival bookkeeping. 0x82D6222C onward keeps later animation work, including calls 0x82D62480/BC and 0x82D62B7C to 0x82D5E568.
snapAndCompletion.tail: 0x82D62CF4..0x82D62D04 performs native unit flag cleanup only when there is no selected active work. Accepted non-specialized caller completion remains 0x82CD75C4 and command tail 0x82CE16AC.
snapAndCompletion.qualification: Coordinate snap is not a unit+0x22=FFFF finish or proof that all child action clocks, camera, busy sources or command wait finish immediately.

cameraBoundary.helper: 0x82D5CD78..0x82D5CE4C selects aggregate auxiliary +0x4C and +0x70 and writes focus 0x82F771C4 and 0x82F772D0; when aggregate X<=0 it uses logical unit coordinates instead.
cameraBoundary.qualification: The selected helper shows coordinate publication, not a non-specialized move invocation or applied engine camera, follow or restoration behavior. Accepted F0064 zero-sample discriminator remains scoped to its exact tested edge.

candidateBoundary.fast: Default-off experiment at 0x82D619AC after native quotient 0x82D619A8, applied only when its conditions hold: scale only validated positive r27, whose value is limited, keeping the subsequent threshold and translation and the native action and tail. Check scaled quantum and q+q/2 overflow; invalid inputs fall back.
candidateBoundary.instant: Default-off experiment at 0x82D619BC, applied only when its conditions hold: for one validated tagged non-specialized Move17 child, take native fallthrough 0x82D619C0 while preserving current registers, condition state, frame and all later native work. This proposes first-update translation snap, not no-wait or full skeletal-animation suppression.
candidateBoundary.admission: Correlate one non-specialized Move17 owner and slot, I, child, and the lifetime of the active synchronous request and thread. No blanket unit-type or global-clock override is selected. Stale or unrelated identities fall back.
exclusions: transport and formation variants until separately observed
modal interruption and cross-turn route continuation
rail, teleport, ship and aircraft equivalence
per-peer differing policy without authority proof
candidateBoundary.qualification: Owner equality and visibility paths do not distinguish AI from another human. Adjacent commands do not prove multi-step route parity. Keep fog, ZOC, city, linked-unit and AI ordering native; no accelerated parity was observed.

guards: Do not mutate the rejected shared cooldown 0x830E4548 or shared frame delta 0x8314F04C.
Do not write 0x830E4550 as a local preference or manually clear shared busy.
Do not mutate logical movement budget, tile position, queued destination, move step or lifecycle flags.
Keep presenter, pump, all action and child bookkeeping and exactly-once non-specialized completion.
No peer-local safety, save equivalence or runtime acceleration follows from this static candidate.
conclusion: The selected native unit-child translation uses a per-frame integer quantum and a native snap to exact coordinates. These provide narrow points for Fast and Instant diagnostics. A complete setting is not yet established because the updater's acceptance of an actual Move17, child animation and model completion, camera application, specialized cases and peer authority require runtime observation. This finite static assessment closes without skipping the native state machine.
